Closest in space, time, or relationship.
Directly connected to something, without anything coming between.

ex.en: The leaking pipe needs immediate attention before the kitchen floods.
ex.zh: 这根漏水的管子需要立即处理，免得厨房被淹。

ex.en: Governments should take immediate action to protect communities facing severe water shortages during prolonged droughts.
ex.zh: 政府应立即采取行动，保护那些在长期干旱中面临严重缺水的社区。

tip: immediate是形容词；修饰动词用immediately。

senses.zh: 令人赞叹的；令人钦佩的
senses.en: Causing admiration because of exceptional quality, size, or skill.

ex.en: You made an impressive cake for your first attempt.
ex.zh: 你第一次尝试就做出了这么出色的蛋糕。

ex.en: The region has made impressive progress in expanding access to clean water over the past decade.
ex.zh: 过去十年，该地区在扩大清洁用水覆盖范围方面取得了显著进展。

tip: 事物令人赞叹用impressive；人感到佩服用impressed。

senses.en: Money received regularly from work, investments, or other sources.

ex.en: My weekend job gives me a small extra income.
ex.zh: 我的周末兼职给我带来一小笔额外收入。

ex.en: Affordable public transport allows families on low incomes to access employment and essential services more easily.
ex.zh: 价格实惠的公共交通让低收入家庭更容易获得就业机会和基本服务。

tip: income范围比salary广，也包括租金、投资收益。

senses.en: An aircraft powered by jet engines.
A narrow, forceful stream of liquid or gas.

ex.en: A jet flew low over the beach this morning.
ex.zh: 今天早上一架喷气式飞机低空飞过海滩。

ex.en: Replacing older passenger jets with more efficient aircraft could reduce fuel consumption across the aviation industry.
ex.zh: 用效率更高的飞机替换老旧客机，可以降低整个航空业的燃料消耗。

tip: a jet of water指一股喷射的水流。

senses.en: A group of sports teams that regularly compete against one another.
An association of people or groups sharing a common purpose.
A level of quality, ability, or achievement.

ex.en: Our team finished top of the league this season.
ex.zh: 我们队本赛季在联赛中排名第一。

ex.en: A local sports league can strengthen community ties by bringing together players from different social backgrounds.
ex.zh: 地方体育联赛可以让不同社会背景的球员聚在一起，从而加强社区联系。

tip: in a different league常指水平远胜一筹。

senses.en: To speak to a god to ask, thank, or worship.
To hope very strongly that something will happen.

ex.en: They gather quietly each morning to pray for peace.
ex.zh: 他们每天早晨静静地聚在一起，为和平祈祷。

ex.en: Providing quiet spaces allows people of different faiths to pray while studying or working on campus.
ex.zh: 提供安静的空间能让不同信仰的人在校园学习或工作期间祈祷。

tip: pray to 接祈祷对象，pray for 接所求之事。

senses.en: Someone who studies a subject carefully to discover new information.

ex.en: The researcher carefully examined the leaf under a microscope.
ex.zh: 研究人员用显微镜仔细观察了这片叶子。

ex.en: Researchers are investigating how access to green spaces influences the mental health of urban residents.
ex.zh: 研究人员正在探究接触绿地如何影响城市居民的心理健康。

tip: researcher可数；research作名词通常不可数。

senses.en: extra and available to use when needed
to give time or resources that you can make available
to prevent someone from experiencing harm or difficulty

ex.en: I keep a spare umbrella in my car.
ex.zh: 我在车里放了一把备用伞。

ex.en: People who can spare a few hours each week could support local charities through regular volunteering.
ex.zh: 每周能抽出几个小时的人，可以通过定期做志愿者来支持当地慈善机构。

tip: spare time是空闲时间；spare作动词可指抽出。

senses.en: A sculpture representing a person or animal.

ex.en: A bronze statue of a horse stands beside the fountain.
ex.zh: 喷泉旁矗立着一座马的铜像。

ex.en: Public statues can preserve local history, but communities should discuss which figures deserve such recognition.
ex.zh: 公共雕像可以保存地方历史，但社区应讨论哪些人物值得获得这样的认可。

tip: statue是雕像；status是地位，注意拼写区别。

senses.en: likely to damage physical or mental health
not in good physical condition
harmful or excessive in a way that causes problems

ex.en: Eating only biscuits for dinner is an unhealthy habit.
ex.zh: 晚餐只吃饼干是个不健康的习惯。

ex.en: Advertising unhealthy foods to children may contribute to poor dietary habits and higher rates of obesity.
ex.zh: 向儿童投放不健康食品广告，可能导致不良饮食习惯和更高的肥胖率。

tip: unhealthy可指事物伤身，也可指身体状况差。

senses.en: to transfer files from a device to an online system
the transfer of a file online, or the file itself

ex.en: I uploaded our picnic photos to a shared folder.
ex.zh: 我把我们野餐的照片上传到了共享文件夹。

ex.en: Students can upload their assignments to a secure platform, allowing teachers to provide timely feedback.
ex.zh: 学生可以将作业上传至安全平台，方便教师及时提供反馈。

tip: 上传用upload，下载用download；上传至某处用to。

senses.en: Needing immediate attention or action

ex.en: The plumber came quickly because the leak was urgent.
ex.zh: 漏水急需处理，所以水管工很快就赶来了。

ex.en: There is an urgent need for affordable housing as urban populations continue to grow.
ex.zh: 随着城市人口持续增长，人们迫切需要负担得起的住房。

tip: urgent强调必须立即处理，不仅是重要。

senses.en: A spiritual being believed to carry messages from God
Someone who is exceptionally kind or helpful

ex.en: The painting shows an angel with shining white wings.
ex.zh: 这幅画描绘了一位长着洁白耀眼翅膀的天使。

ex.en: Images of angels appear in religious art and can reveal important aspects of a society's beliefs.
ex.zh: 天使形象出现在宗教艺术中，能够揭示一个社会信仰的重要方面。

tip: 称某人为an angel，可表示对方善良或帮了大忙。

senses.en: A room or floor below ground level in a building.

ex.en: We keep our bicycles in the basement during winter.
ex.zh: 冬天我们把自行车放在地下室里。

ex.en: Converting unused basement space into community facilities can help densely populated neighbourhoods accommodate more activities.
ex.zh: 将闲置的地下室空间改造成社区设施，有助于人口密集的街区容纳更多活动。

tip: basement可作居住空间；cellar通常指地下储藏室。

senses.en: the grounds and buildings belonging to a university or college

ex.en: We found a quiet bench near the campus library.
ex.zh: 我们在校园图书馆附近找到了一张安静的长椅。

ex.en: Providing affordable accommodation on campus can help students spend less time commuting and more time studying.
ex.zh: 提供价格合理的校内住宿可以帮助学生减少通勤时间，增加学习时间。

tip: 表示“在校园内”通常用on campus，不加冠词。

senses.en: A substance produced or used in a chemical process.
Relating to substances and how they combine or change.

ex.en: Keep cleaning chemicals safely out of children's reach.
ex.zh: 请将清洁用化学品安全存放在儿童接触不到的地方。

ex.en: Farmers can protect nearby rivers by reducing the amount of agricultural chemicals used on their land.
ex.zh: 农民可以通过减少农田中农业化学品的用量来保护附近的河流。

tip: chemical作名词可数；化学物质不一定有害。

senses.en: Causing suffering without caring about others' feelings.
Causing great suffering or disappointment.

ex.en: It was cruel to laugh at her mistake.
ex.zh: 嘲笑她的错误很刻薄。

ex.en: Schools should address cruel behaviour early to ensure that every child feels safe and respected.
ex.zh: 学校应及早处理伤害他人的行为，确保每个孩子都感到安全并受到尊重。

tip: 表示对某人或动物残忍，用be cruel to。

senses.en: A person or organisation that pays people to work.

ex.en: My employer lets me work from home on Fridays.
ex.zh: 我的雇主允许我每周五在家办公。

ex.en: Employers can improve staff retention by offering fair wages, flexible schedules, and opportunities for professional development.
ex.zh: 雇主可以通过提供公平的薪资、灵活的工作安排和职业发展机会来提高员工留任率。

tip: employer是雇主；employee是雇员。

senses.en: relating to money or how it is managed

ex.en: We asked for financial advice before buying our first home.
ex.zh: 购买第一套住房前，我们咨询了理财建议。

ex.en: Financial support for disadvantaged students can improve access to higher education and reduce long-term inequality.
ex.zh: 为弱势学生提供经济支持可以增加他们接受高等教育的机会，并减少长期存在的不平等。

tip: financial侧重金钱与财务；economic侧重经济整体。

senses.en: someone who behaves without good sense or judgment
to make someone believe something that is not true

ex.en: The realistic plastic spider fooled everyone at the party.
ex.zh: 那只逼真的塑料蜘蛛骗过了聚会上的所有人。

ex.en: Misleading advertisements can fool consumers into buying products that offer little practical benefit.
ex.zh: 误导性广告可能诱使消费者购买几乎没有实际用处的产品。

tip: fool作名词称呼别人有贬义；动词可接into doing。

senses.en: Attractive in appearance, especially describing a man.
Large and impressive in amount.

ex.en: My brother looks handsome in his new blue jacket.
ex.zh: 我哥哥穿着新的蓝色夹克，看起来很英俊。

ex.en: Companies investing in renewable energy may earn handsome profits as demand for cleaner alternatives continues to grow.
ex.zh: 随着对更清洁替代能源的需求持续增长，投资可再生能源的企业可能获得丰厚利润。

tip: 常形容男子英俊；形容利润或报酬时意为丰厚的。

senses.en: A shaped frame used to hang clothes.

ex.en: She put her jacket on a wooden hanger.
ex.zh: 她把夹克挂在一个木衣架上。

ex.en: Retailers can reduce plastic waste by collecting used hangers and replacing damaged ones with recyclable alternatives.
ex.zh: 零售商可以回收旧衣架，并用可回收的替代品更换损坏的衣架，从而减少塑料垃圾。

tip: hanger是衣架；hangar是飞机库，注意拼写。

senses.en: an object played to produce musical sounds
a tool or device for precise scientific or medical work
something used to achieve a particular purpose

ex.en: My sister plays a different instrument at each rehearsal.
ex.zh: 我姐姐每次排练都演奏不同的乐器。

ex.en: Learning a musical instrument can strengthen concentration and encourage cooperation among children from different backgrounds.
ex.zh: 学习乐器可以增强专注力，并促进不同背景的儿童之间的合作。

tip: 乐器和精密仪器均可用instrument；普通工具常用tool。

senses.en: In, from, or relating to the north.

ex.en: My grandparents live in a quiet northern village.
ex.zh: 我的祖父母住在北方一个安静的村庄。

ex.en: Northern regions often face higher heating costs, making energy efficiency particularly important for local households.
ex.zh: 北部地区的供暖费用往往较高，因此提高能源效率对当地家庭尤其重要。

tip: northern是形容词，常置于region、coast等名词前。

senses.en: during the night or for one night
very quickly or suddenly
happening during or lasting for one night

ex.en: We stayed overnight at a small hotel near the station.
ex.zh: 我们在车站附近的一家小旅馆住了一夜。

ex.en: Investment in public transport can improve urban mobility, but meaningful changes rarely happen overnight.
ex.zh: 投资公共交通可以改善城市出行，但实质性变化很少能一夜实现。

tip: 表“一夜之间”时，常强调变化快，不一定真是一夜。

senses.en: A juicy fruit with fuzzy skin and a large hard stone
Having a pale pinkish orange colour

ex.en: She sliced a ripe peach into her breakfast bowl.
ex.zh: 她把一个熟桃切成片，放进早餐碗里。

ex.en: Peach growers may face reduced harvests when unusually warm winters disrupt the trees' natural flowering cycle.
ex.zh: 冬季异常温暖会扰乱桃树的自然开花周期，桃农可能因此面临减产。

tip: 桃核英式常说 stone，美式常说 pit。

senses.en: to continue to be in the same state
to stay in a place rather than leave
to still exist after other things have gone

ex.en: Please remain seated until the bus has stopped completely.
ex.zh: 请留在座位上，直到公交车完全停稳。

ex.en: Despite improvements in public transport, private cars remain the main means of travel in many rural areas.
ex.zh: 尽管公共交通有所改善，私家车仍是许多农村地区的主要出行工具。

tip: 表示保持某状态时，后接形容词或名词，不用副词。

senses.en: a person or business that sells something

ex.en: The seller wrapped the vase carefully before handing it over.
ex.zh: 卖家仔细包好花瓶后才递过来。

ex.en: Online marketplaces should require each seller to provide accurate product information and clear policies for returns.
ex.zh: 网络交易平台应要求每个卖家提供准确的产品信息和明确的退货政策。

tip: seller侧重交易中的卖方，不一定是店内售货员。

senses.en: Having a smooth surface that reflects light.

ex.en: She polished her shoes until they looked shiny.
ex.zh: 她把鞋擦得亮亮的。

ex.en: Shiny packaging may attract consumers, but it often creates waste that is difficult to recycle.
ex.zh: 亮丽的包装可能吸引消费者，但往往会产生难以回收的废弃物。

tip: 指表面反光，不等于物体本身发光。

senses.en: a story, especially one involving imaginary or exciting events
an account of something that happened to someone

ex.en: Grandfather told us a tale about a clever fox.
ex.zh: 祖父给我们讲了一个聪明狐狸的故事。

ex.en: Traditional tales can preserve cultural values while helping children explore complex emotions through memorable characters.
ex.zh: 传统故事既能传承文化价值观，也能通过令人难忘的角色帮助儿童探索复杂情感。

tip: tale指故事；tail指尾巴，两者同音。

senses.en: not sure about something
not known, settled, or predictable

ex.en: I felt uncertain about which jacket to buy.
ex.zh: 我拿不定主意该买哪件夹克。

ex.en: The long-term effects of remote working remain uncertain, particularly for younger employees entering the labour market.
ex.zh: 远程工作的长期影响仍不明确，对刚进入劳动力市场的年轻员工而言尤其如此。

tip: 人没把握用uncertain about；事情未定用remain uncertain。

senses.en: A tiny infectious agent that reproduces inside living cells
Harmful computer code that spreads by infecting files or programs

ex.en: The doctor said a virus was causing my cough.
ex.zh: 医生说我的咳嗽是由病毒引起的。

ex.en: Public health campaigns can limit the spread of a virus by encouraging vaccination and regular handwashing.
ex.zh: 公共卫生宣传可以通过鼓励接种疫苗和经常洗手来限制病毒传播。

tip: virus是病毒，bacterium是细菌；两者不能混用。

senses.en: Containing alcohol.

senses.zh: 酒精依赖的；酒精引起的
senses.en: Affected by alcohol dependence, or caused by alcohol.
A person who is dependent on alcohol.

ex.en: The waiter asked whether we wanted any alcoholic drinks.
ex.zh: 服务员问我们是否需要含酒精的饮品。

ex.en: Clear information about alcoholic beverages can help consumers understand health risks and make more informed choices.
ex.zh: 关于酒精饮品的清晰信息可以帮助消费者了解健康风险，并作出更明智的选择。

tip: 指人时宜用person with alcohol dependence，更尊重。

senses.en: A date marking another year since an important event.

ex.en: We cooked a special meal for our wedding anniversary.
ex.zh: 我们为结婚纪念日做了一顿特别的饭菜。

ex.en: The museum celebrated its anniversary by offering free admission to encourage more residents to explore local history.
ex.zh: 博物馆在周年纪念日提供免费入场，鼓励更多居民了解当地历史。

tip: 指重要事件每年对应的纪念日，不只用于婚礼。

senses.en: Creative activities such as painting, music, theatre, and dance.
Subjects such as languages, literature, philosophy, and history.

ex.en: Our local arts centre offers pottery and dance classes.
ex.zh: 我们当地的艺术中心开设陶艺课和舞蹈课。

ex.en: Studying arts subjects can develop critical thinking and deepen students' understanding of different cultures.
ex.zh: 学习文科科目可以培养批判性思维，加深学生对不同文化的理解。

tip: the arts 指艺术的总称；arts subjects 指文科科目。

senses.en: a small, usually round fruit, often growing in clusters

ex.en: She dropped a ripe berry into her bowl of yoghurt.
ex.zh: 她把一颗熟透的莓果放进酸奶碗里。

ex.en: Protecting native shrubs ensures that birds have access to berries and other food sources throughout the year.
ex.zh: 保护本地灌木可以确保鸟类全年都能获取浆果及其他食物。

tip: 复数为berries；日常用法与植物学定义有差异。

senses.en: Unpleasantly cold, though usually not extremely cold.
Showing little warmth or friendliness towards someone.

ex.en: It felt chilly outside, so I grabbed my jacket.
ex.zh: 外面有些冷，所以我拿上了夹克。

ex.en: Providing warm public spaces during chilly weather can help protect older residents from cold-related illnesses.
ex.zh: 在寒冷天气提供温暖的公共场所，有助于保护老年居民免受寒冷引发的疾病侵害。

tip: chilly比freezing程度轻，也可形容态度冷淡。

senses.en: To establish that something is true or correct.
To make an arrangement certain or give it official approval.

ex.en: Please call the hotel to confirm our booking today.
ex.zh: 请今天给酒店打电话，确认我们的预订。

ex.en: Further research is needed to confirm whether smaller classes consistently improve learning outcomes in primary schools.
ex.zh: 还需要进一步研究，以证实小学小班教学是否能持续改善学习效果。

tip: 可接名词或that从句；不要用confirm to do。

senses.en: Relating to trade, industry, money, or the study of these.

ex.en: The news discussed economic problems affecting local shops.
ex.zh: 新闻讨论了影响当地商店的经济问题。

ex.en: Investment in public transport can support economic growth by connecting workers with a wider range of jobs.
ex.zh: 投资公共交通能让劳动者获得更广泛的就业机会，从而促进经济增长。

tip: economic指经济方面的；economical指节约的。

senses.en: A liquid fuel used in cars and other engines.

ex.en: We stopped to buy gasoline before crossing the desert.
ex.zh: 穿越沙漠之前，我们停车加了汽油。

ex.en: Higher gasoline prices may encourage commuters to share cars or switch to public transport.
ex.zh: 汽油价格上涨可能促使通勤者拼车或改乘公共交通。

tip: 美式英语用gasoline，口语常说gas；英式通常用petrol。

senses.en: to demand something firmly despite disagreement
to state firmly that something is true

ex.en: My grandparents insist on paying for lunch every time.
ex.zh: 我的祖父母每次都坚持要付午餐钱。

ex.en: Many parents insist that schools provide regular physical education, even when academic subjects compete for classroom time.
ex.zh: 即使文化课挤占课时，许多家长仍坚决要求学校定期开设体育课。

tip: 用insist on doing，不用insist to do。

senses.en: the quality of caring about others and helping them
an act that helps someone or shows care

ex.en: Her kindness made our new neighbour feel welcome.
ex.zh: 她的体贴让新邻居感受到了欢迎。

ex.en: Schools can encourage kindness by giving students opportunities to support classmates who face personal difficulties.
ex.zh: 学校可以让学生有机会帮助遇到个人困难的同学，从而培养他们的善意。

tip: 指善良品质时不可数；指具体善举时可数。

senses.en: A person or company that produces something.

ex.en: The furniture maker carved a beautiful chair from oak.
ex.zh: 这位家具工匠用橡木雕出了一把漂亮的椅子。

ex.en: Car makers are investing in cleaner technologies to meet stricter environmental standards and changing consumer expectations.
ex.zh: 汽车制造商正在投资更清洁的技术，以满足更严格的环保标准和不断变化的消费者期望。

tip: 常与产品名搭配；决策者用decision maker。

senses.en: Something made by combining two or more different things.

ex.en: Stir the mixture until it becomes smooth and creamy.
ex.zh: 搅拌混合物，直到它变得顺滑绵密。

ex.en: Successful cities offer a mixture of affordable housing, reliable transport, and accessible public spaces.
ex.zh: 成功的城市兼具可负担的住房、可靠的交通和方便使用的公共空间。

tip: a mixture of 后可接物质，也可接情感等抽象事物。

senses.en: an amount expressed as a fraction of one hundred

ex.en: What percentage of your monthly income goes on rent?
ex.zh: 你每月收入的百分之多少用于付房租？

ex.en: The percentage of households using renewable energy has increased as installation costs have fallen in recent years.
ex.zh: 近年来，随着安装成本下降，使用可再生能源的家庭比例有所上升。

tip: 数字后用percent；谈比例用percentage。

senses.en: An object kept to remember a place, person, or event.

ex.en: We bought a small wooden boat as a souvenir.
ex.zh: 我们买了一只小木船作为纪念品。

ex.en: Buying a locally made souvenir can support traditional crafts and provide income for communities that depend on tourism.
ex.zh: 购买当地制作的纪念品可以支持传统工艺，并为依靠旅游业的社区带来收入。

tip: 常用a souvenir of表示某次旅行或活动的纪念品。

senses.en: Dried cereal stems used for animal bedding and other purposes.
A narrow tube used for drinking liquids.

ex.en: The farmer spread fresh straw across the barn floor.
ex.zh: 农民在谷仓地上铺了一层新鲜的麦秆。

ex.en: Replacing plastic straws with reusable alternatives can reduce waste, although wider changes in consumption remain necessary.
ex.zh: 用可重复使用的替代品取代塑料吸管能减少废物，但仍需更广泛地改变消费方式。

col: 令人忍无可忍的最后一击
tip: 作稻草时不可数，作吸管时可数；hay指干草饲料。

senses.en: Water falling from a height over a steep rock face

ex.en: We could hear the waterfall long before we saw it.
ex.zh: 还没看见瀑布，我们就远远听到了水声。

ex.en: Tourism near a waterfall can support local businesses, but visitor facilities should protect the surrounding natural habitat.
ex.zh: 瀑布附近的旅游业可以带动当地商业，但游客设施应保护周围的自然栖息地。

tip: 可数名词：一处瀑布用a waterfall。

senses.en: Someone whose job is to prepare and check financial records

ex.en: The accountant checked our expenses before we opened the café.
ex.zh: 咖啡馆开业前，会计核查了我们的各项开支。

ex.en: Employing a qualified accountant helps small businesses manage taxes accurately and make better financial decisions.
ex.zh: 聘用合格的会计师有助于小企业准确处理税务，并作出更好的财务决策。

tip: accountant指人；accounting指会计工作或学科。

senses.en: To make information known publicly or officially.

ex.en: Our teacher announced the winners after lunch today.
ex.zh: 今天午饭后，我们的老师宣布了获奖者。

ex.en: Local authorities should announce major policy changes early so residents have enough time to prepare.
ex.zh: 地方政府应尽早公布重大政策调整，让居民有充足的准备时间。

tip: 用announce sth或announce that，不用announce sb sth。

senses.en: a vegetable with large leaves forming a firm round head

ex.en: She sliced the cabbage thinly and added it to soup.
ex.zh: 她把卷心菜切成细丝，放进汤里。

ex.en: Locally grown vegetables such as cabbage can support healthier diets while reducing the environmental impact of food transport.
ex.zh: 卷心菜等本地种植的蔬菜有助于改善饮食健康，同时减少食品运输对环境的影响。

tip: 整颗可数：a cabbage；作为食材通常不可数。

senses.zh: 有组织的运动；宣传活动
senses.en: A series of organised activities aimed at achieving a goal
To organise or take part in activities supporting a cause
A series of military operations with a particular objective

ex.en: Our school launched a campaign to reduce food waste.
ex.zh: 我们学校发起了一项减少食物浪费的活动。

ex.en: Public health campaigns can encourage healthier habits, especially when supported by affordable access to nutritious food.
ex.zh: 公共卫生宣传活动能促进更健康的习惯，尤其是在居民能够负担并获得营养食物的情况下。

tip: 动词后接for表示争取，接against表示反对。

senses.en: a thin, crisp biscuit, often eaten with cheese

ex.en: I packed some crackers and cheese for the picnic.
ex.zh: 我装了些薄脆饼干和奶酪，准备野餐时吃。

ex.en: Although crackers are convenient snacks, some varieties contain substantial amounts of salt and should be eaten in moderation.
ex.zh: 虽然薄脆饼干食用方便，但某些种类含盐量较高，应适量食用。

tip: 通常指薄而脆的咸饼干，不一定是苏打饼干。

senses.en: a ceremonial headpiece worn by a king or queen
to officially make someone a monarch or declare them champion
the highest part of a head, tree, or other object

ex.en: The queen wore a golden crown during the ceremony.
ex.zh: 女王在仪式上戴着一顶金色王冠。

ex.en: A royal crown displayed in a museum can reveal historical attitudes towards wealth, authority, and craftsmanship.
ex.zh: 博物馆里展出的王冠可以揭示历史上人们对财富、权威和工艺的态度。

tip: be crowned champion意为“被授予冠军称号”。

senses.en: a period of ten years

ex.en: They have lived on this street for a decade.
ex.zh: 他们在这条街上已经住了十年。

ex.en: Over the past decade, digital technology has significantly changed how people access education and healthcare.
ex.zh: 过去十年间，数字技术显著改变了人们获取教育和医疗服务的方式。

tip: a decade是十年；decades常泛指数十年。

senses.en: to protect someone or something from attack or harm
to give reasons supporting someone or something being criticised
to prevent opponents from scoring in a sport

ex.en: The mother duck spread her wings to defend her ducklings.
ex.zh: 鸭妈妈张开翅膀保护小鸭。

ex.en: Governments should defend citizens' rights while ensuring that public safety measures remain fair and proportionate.
ex.zh: 政府应捍卫公民权利，同时确保公共安全措施公平且适度。

tip: defend ... against/from ...表示保护……免受……。

senses.en: Unable to think or act normally after drinking alcohol
So excited by something that sensible judgment is lost
Someone who is drunk or frequently drinks too much alcohol

ex.en: He was too drunk to walk home safely.
ex.zh: 他醉得无法安全步行回家。

ex.en: Public awareness campaigns can help reduce accidents caused by drunk drivers, especially among younger adults.
ex.zh: 公众宣传活动有助于减少酒驾造成的事故，尤其是在年轻成年人中。

tip: drunk通常作表语；修饰名词也常用drunken。

senses.en: A space in a wall where a fire burns.

ex.en: We warmed our feet beside the fireplace after dinner.
ex.zh: 晚饭后，我们在壁炉旁暖脚。

ex.en: Traditional homes often feature a fireplace, although modern heating systems are generally more convenient.
ex.zh: 传统住宅通常设有壁炉，不过现代供暖系统一般更方便。

col: light a fire in the fireplace
tip: 壁炉是fireplace；壁炉架通常叫mantelpiece。

senses.en: unhappy because someone has something you want

senses.zh: 因担心失去爱而吃醋的
senses.en: upset because someone you love shows interest in another person

ex.en: I felt jealous when my cousin got a bicycle.
ex.zh: 表弟得到一辆自行车时，我心里很嫉妒。

ex.en: Social media can make users jealous of others whose lives appear more successful or exciting.
ex.zh: 社交媒体可能让用户嫉妒那些生活看起来更成功或更精彩的人。

tip: 常用be jealous of；既可指嫉妒，也可指吃醋。

senses.en: A structure built to honour a person or important event.
An old structure valued for its historical importance.

ex.en: We left flowers beside the monument in the town square.
ex.zh: 我们把鲜花放在镇广场的纪念碑旁。

ex.en: Protecting ancient monuments can strengthen cultural identity while attracting visitors and supporting employment in local communities.
ex.zh: 保护古迹既能增强文化认同，又能吸引游客，为当地社区创造就业机会。

tip: 纪念某人或某事用a monument to。

senses.en: used to add another negative statement or alternative

ex.en: I could neither find my keys nor remember where I parked.
ex.zh: 我既找不到钥匙，也记不起把车停在哪里了。

ex.en: Expanding roads alone will neither solve traffic congestion nor reduce the environmental damage caused by private vehicles.
ex.zh: 仅仅拓宽道路既不能解决交通拥堵，也无法减少私家车造成的环境破坏。

tip: nor连接独立分句时常倒装：nor do I。

senses.en: damage to the environment caused by harmful substances or energy

ex.en: Air pollution makes the distant hills difficult to see.
ex.zh: 空气污染让远处的山丘难以看清。

ex.en: Reducing pollution requires governments to regulate industrial emissions while encouraging cleaner transport and more sustainable production methods.
ex.zh: 减少污染需要政府监管工业排放，同时鼓励更清洁的交通方式和更可持续的生产方式。

tip: pollution不可数；具体污染物用pollutant。

senses.en: all people living in an area, or their total number
all organisms of one species living in a particular area

ex.en: The village population grows when families move here.
ex.zh: 有家庭搬来时，村里的人口就会增加。

ex.en: An ageing population can place additional pressure on healthcare systems and increase demand for accessible public transport.
ex.zh: 人口老龄化会给医疗系统带来额外压力，并增加对无障碍公共交通的需求。

tip: 人口多或少用large或small，不用many或few。

senses.en: a way taken to get from one place to another
to send someone or something along a particular path

ex.en: We took a different route home to avoid traffic.
ex.zh: 我们换了一条路线回家，以避开拥堵。

ex.en: Expanding bus routes to rural communities would improve access to employment and essential public services.
ex.zh: 将公交线路延伸至农村社区，有助于居民获得就业机会和基本公共服务。

tip: 美式也读 /raʊt/；route 强调行进路线。

senses.en: Relating to a king, queen, or their family.
A member of a royal family.

ex.en: We visited the royal palace during our holiday.
ex.zh: 我们度假时参观了王宫。

ex.en: Some royal residences are open to visitors, generating income that helps preserve historic buildings.
ex.zh: 一些王室住所向游客开放，所得收入有助于保护历史建筑。

tip: royal指王室的；loyal指忠诚的，注意首字母。

senses.en: Move against a surface with pressure, often repeatedly.
An act of pressing and moving against a surface.

ex.en: She rubbed her cold hands together beside the heater.
ex.zh: 她在暖气旁搓着冰冷的双手。

ex.en: Protective gloves prevent workers from rubbing their skin against rough surfaces when handling heavy materials.
ex.zh: 搬运重物时，防护手套可以避免工人的皮肤与粗糙表面摩擦。

tip: 过去式rubbed、现在分词rubbing均双写b。

senses.zh: 科学的；符合科学方法的
senses.en: relating to science or using methods based on evidence

ex.en: Our class used scientific methods to test the water.
ex.zh: 我们班用科学方法检测了水质。

ex.en: Governments should rely on scientific evidence when developing policies to protect public health.
ex.zh: 政府在制定保护公众健康的政策时，应依据科学证据。

tip: scientific强调科学依据，不等于仅仅有条理。

senses.en: To mix something by moving a spoon or similar object around.
To cause a strong feeling or reaction.
Excitement or surprise caused by an event or action.

ex.en: Stir the soup gently so it does not stick.
ex.zh: 轻轻搅拌汤，免得粘锅。

ex.en: Documentaries about endangered animals can stir public concern and encourage stronger support for wildlife conservation.
ex.zh: 关于濒危动物的纪录片能够唤起公众的关注，促使人们更加支持野生动物保护。

tip: 过去式stirred、现在分词stirring均双写r。

senses.en: Thin cord used for tying or fastening things.
A stretched wire or thread that produces musical sounds.
A series of connected things or events.

ex.en: I tied the parcel with a piece of string.
ex.zh: 我用一根细绳把包裹绑好了。

ex.en: A string of successful conservation projects has demonstrated the value of involving local communities in environmental protection.
ex.zh: 一系列成功的自然保护项目证明了让当地社区参与环境保护的价值。

tip: 绳线通常不可数；琴弦及a string of中的string可数。

senses.en: A sweet-smelling substance from tropical plant pods, used to flavour food.
Flavoured with vanilla.

ex.en: Add a little vanilla before you mix the batter.
ex.zh: 搅拌面糊之前，加一点香草精。

ex.en: Demand for natural vanilla can provide valuable income for farmers, but unstable prices create financial risks.
ex.zh: 对天然香草的需求能为农民带来可观收入，但价格不稳定会造成财务风险。

tip: 食品中的vanilla指特定香料，并非泛指所有香草。

senses.zh: 英式贴身背心；美式马甲
senses.en: a sleeveless garment worn underneath or over other clothes
to formally give someone a right, power, or responsibility

ex.en: I wore a cotton vest under my shirt today.
ex.zh: 今天我在衬衫里面穿了一件棉背心。

ex.en: The constitution vests executive authority in elected officials, who remain accountable to the public through regular elections.
ex.zh: 宪法将行政权赋予民选官员，他们通过定期选举继续向公众负责。

tip: 英式vest常指贴身背心；美式常指英式waistcoat。

senses.en: the act of putting something extra into something
the process of finding the total of quantities
something extra that joins an existing group or collection

ex.en: The addition of fresh lemon made the soup delicious.
ex.zh: 加入新鲜柠檬后，汤变得十分美味。

ex.en: The addition of cycle lanes can make urban transport safer and encourage residents to exercise regularly.
ex.zh: 增设自行车道可以提高城市交通的安全性，并鼓励居民经常锻炼。

tip: in addition作连接语；in addition to后接名词或动名词。

senses.en: A water-filled container for keeping fish and other aquatic animals
A public building where people can see aquatic animals

ex.en: Two orange fish swim among plants in our aquarium.
ex.zh: 两条橙色的鱼在我们鱼缸里的水草间游动。

ex.en: A well-managed aquarium can teach visitors about marine ecosystems and encourage greater concern for ocean conservation.
ex.zh: 管理良好的水族馆可以让游客了解海洋生态系统，并促使他们更加关注海洋保护。

tip: 既指家中的鱼缸，也指供公众参观的水族馆。

senses.en: A fight between armed forces.
A difficult struggle to achieve something or overcome a problem.
To struggle hard against someone or something.

ex.en: The museum displays armour from a famous battle.
ex.zh: 博物馆展出了某场著名战役中使用的盔甲。

ex.en: The battle against air pollution requires coordinated action from governments, businesses, and individuals across urban areas.
ex.zh: 对抗空气污染需要城市各地的政府、企业和个人协调行动。

tip: battle可指具体战斗，也常比喻与疾病或困难抗争。

senses.en: To become curved or make something curved.
To move your body downwards or forwards from the waist.
A curved section of a road, river, or other long object.

ex.en: Bend the wire gently to make a small hook.
ex.zh: 轻轻弯曲铁丝，做成一个小钩子。

ex.en: Drivers should reduce their speed before approaching a sharp bend, especially when road conditions are poor.
ex.zh: 驾驶员在接近急弯前应减速，尤其是在路况不佳时。

tip: 过去式和过去分词均为bent；bend down表示弯下腰。

senses.en: a plant grown in large quantities for food or other uses
the amount of a plant harvested at one time
to remove outer parts of an image or cut hair short

ex.en: The farmer checked his wheat crop after the storm.
ex.zh: 暴风雨过后，农民查看了自己的小麦。

ex.en: Rising temperatures may reduce crop yields, threatening food security in regions that already experience water shortages.
ex.zh: 气温上升可能导致农作物减产，威胁本就缺水地区的粮食安全。

tip: crop既指庄稼也指收成；动词可指裁剪照片。

senses.en: Clearly decided or known, without uncertainty.
Clearly noticeable or unquestionably present.

ex.en: We need a definite answer before booking the tickets.
ex.zh: 订票之前，我们需要一个明确的答复。

ex.en: Reliable public transport offers definite advantages for cities seeking to reduce congestion and improve air quality.
ex.zh: 对于寻求缓解拥堵和改善空气质量的城市来说，可靠的公共交通具有明显优势。

tip: definite是形容词；definitely是副词，意为肯定地。

senses.en: the desire or need for particular goods or services
a strong request that someone expects to be obeyed
to insist on receiving something or require something essential

ex.en: Demand for cold drinks rises sharply during hot weather.
ex.zh: 天气炎热时，冷饮的需求量急剧上升。

ex.en: Growing demand for affordable housing has encouraged local authorities to convert unused office buildings into residential accommodation.
ex.zh: 对可负担住房不断增长的需求促使地方政府将闲置办公楼改建为住宅。

tip: 要求做某事用demand to do，不用demand sb to do。

senses.en: a prehistoric reptile, often large, known mainly from fossils
a person or thing considered outdated and resistant to change

ex.en: We saw a huge dinosaur skeleton at the museum.
ex.zh: 我们在博物馆看到了一具巨大的恐龙骨架。

ex.en: Studying dinosaur fossils helps researchers understand how ancient environments differed from those of the present day.
ex.zh: 研究恐龙化石有助于科研人员了解古代环境与当今环境的差异。

tip: 比喻人或机构落伍时带贬义，正式交流慎用。

senses.en: The work of organising and controlling activities or resources.
The people responsible for running an organisation.

ex.en: Good time management leaves me free to relax.
ex.zh: 良好的时间管理让我有空放松。

ex.en: Effective waste management requires cooperation between local authorities, businesses, and residents to reduce pollution and conserve resources.
ex.zh: 有效的废物管理需要地方政府、企业和居民合作，以减少污染并节约资源。

tip: 指管理工作时不可数；the management可指管理层。

senses.en: A system of connected people, things or places.
A group of broadcasting stations sharing programmes.
To meet people and develop useful professional relationships.

ex.en: Our home network connects three laptops and a printer.
ex.zh: 我们的家庭网络连接着三台笔记本电脑和一台打印机。

ex.en: An efficient public transport network can reduce traffic congestion and improve access to employment.
ex.zh: 高效的公共交通网络可以缓解交通拥堵，并让人们更方便地前往工作地点。

tip: network强调多个节点之间相互连接。

senses.en: To say what will happen, often using evidence.

ex.en: They predict heavy rain, so take your umbrella.
ex.zh: 他们预报有大雨，所以带上你的伞吧。

ex.en: Climate models help scientists predict how rising temperatures may affect agricultural production in different regions.
ex.zh: 气候模型帮助科学家预测气温上升可能如何影响不同地区的农业生产。

tip: 可接that从句；不要与表示预防的prevent混淆。

senses.en: A statement about what is expected to happen in the future.

ex.en: Your prediction was right: it rained all afternoon.
ex.zh: 你预测对了：整个下午都在下雨。

ex.en: Accurate predictions of future energy demand are essential for planning reliable and sustainable electricity supplies.
ex.zh: 准确预测未来能源需求，对于规划可靠且可持续的电力供应至关重要。

tip: 作出预测用make a prediction，不用do。

senses.en: To put information on an official list
An official list or record of people or things
To show or record an amount on a measuring instrument

ex.en: You can register for swimming lessons at the pool.
ex.zh: 你可以在泳池报名参加游泳课。

ex.en: Residents should be able to register for local healthcare services online, reducing unnecessary travel and administrative delays.
ex.zh: 居民应能在线登记使用当地医疗服务，以减少不必要的出行和行政延误。

tip: 报名课程用register for；登记做某事用register to do。

senses.en: Something that must be done, possessed, or provided
Something needed for a particular purpose

ex.en: Wearing a helmet is a requirement at this skatepark.
ex.zh: 在这个滑板公园必须戴头盔。

ex.en: Clear entry requirements help prospective students assess whether they are adequately prepared for university courses.
ex.zh: 明确的入学要求有助于有意申请的学生判断自己是否已为大学课程做好充分准备。

tip: 满足要求用meet requirements，不用reach。

senses.en: taken from its owner without permission
taken something without permission, as the past participle of steal

ex.en: The police found my stolen bicycle behind a garage.
ex.zh: 警察在一个车库后面找到了我被偷的自行车。

ex.en: Stolen personal data can expose internet users to financial losses, highlighting the importance of effective online security.
ex.zh: 被盗的个人数据可能使互联网用户遭受经济损失，这凸显了有效网络安全措施的重要性。

tip: 变化为steal—stole—stolen；stolen不能单独作过去式。

senses.en: someone you love, especially a romantic partner
a very kind and helpful person

ex.en: My sweetheart brought me flowers after a difficult day.
ex.zh: 辛苦了一天后，我的爱人给我带来了鲜花。

ex.en: Many older adults maintain strong emotional connections with sweethearts they first met during their school years.
ex.zh: 许多年长者与学生时代结识的恋人仍保持着深厚的感情联系。

tip: 可指恋人，也可作亲昵称呼；不宜随意称呼陌生人。

senses.en: a general direction of change or development
to become widely discussed or shared online

ex.en: Growing vegetables at home is a popular trend here.
ex.zh: 在家种菜是这里流行的一种风尚。

ex.en: The growing trend towards remote working may reduce traffic congestion in major cities.
ex.zh: 远程办公日益普及的趋势可能缓解大城市的交通拥堵。

tip: 朝向某种趋势常用a trend towards后接名词。

senses.en: All space and everything that exists within it
A complete world of experiences, ideas, or imagined events

ex.en: We watched a film about stars and the universe.
ex.zh: 我们看了一部关于恒星和宇宙的电影。

ex.en: Research into the origins of the universe has driven advances in telescope technology and data analysis.
ex.zh: 对宇宙起源的研究推动了望远镜技术和数据分析的进步。

tip: 指宇宙通常用the universe；开头是辅音音素/j/。

senses.en: Not expected to happen or be true.
Surprising because someone or something does not seem suitable.

ex.en: With such dark clouds, sunshine seems unlikely this afternoon.
ex.zh: 云层这么黑，今天下午看来不太可能有阳光。

ex.en: Public transport use is unlikely to increase unless services become more reliable and affordable.
ex.zh: 除非服务变得更可靠、票价更实惠，否则公共交通的使用量不太可能增加。

tip: 常用be unlikely to do或It is unlikely that。

senses.en: A very large sea mammal that breathes air.

ex.en: A whale surfaced beside our boat and sprayed water.
ex.zh: 一头鲸在我们船旁浮出水面，喷出了水雾。

ex.en: Protecting whale populations requires international cooperation because these marine mammals migrate across vast areas of ocean.
ex.zh: 保护鲸类种群需要国际合作，因为这些海洋哺乳动物会跨越广阔海域迁徙。

tip: 鲸是哺乳动物，不是鱼；复数通常为whales。

senses.en: a pointed symbol showing direction
a thin pointed object shot from a bow

ex.en: Follow the arrow on the floor to the exit.
ex.zh: 沿着地板上的箭头走到出口。

ex.en: Clear arrows on station floors can improve passenger flow and reduce confusion during busy commuting periods.
ex.zh: 车站地面上清晰的箭头可以改善客流，减少通勤高峰期的混乱。

tip: arrow既指弓射出的“箭”，也指示方向的“箭头”。

senses.en: Make someone interested in or drawn towards something
Pull something closer through a physical force

ex.en: The bright flowers attract butterflies to our small balcony.
ex.zh: 鲜艳的花朵把蝴蝶吸引到我们的小阳台上。

ex.en: Cities that invest in reliable public transport are more likely to attract businesses and skilled workers.
ex.zh: 投资建设可靠公共交通的城市更有可能吸引企业和技术人才。

tip: attract是及物动词，直接接人或事物作宾语。

senses.en: the bags and suitcases you take when travelling
past experiences or feelings that continue to cause difficulties

ex.en: Our baggage arrived on the next flight this afternoon.
ex.zh: 我们的行李今天下午随下一班飞机到了。

ex.en: Airlines often charge additional fees for checked baggage, increasing the overall cost of travel.
ex.zh: 航空公司常对托运行李额外收费，从而增加旅行的总费用。

tip: 不可数；一件行李说a piece of baggage。

senses.en: Confidence that something is true or someone is capable.
An idea accepted as true, especially about life or religion.

ex.en: Her belief in me helped me try again.
ex.zh: 她对我的信心让我愿意再试一次。

ex.en: The belief that education improves social mobility influences government spending priorities in many countries.
ex.zh: 教育能促进社会流动的这一信念影响着许多国家的政府支出重点。

tip: belief in表示信任或信仰；belief that后接具体看法。

senses.en: the dividing line between countries or regions
a strip around the outside edge of something
to share a boundary with a place

ex.en: We crossed the border by train early this morning.
ex.zh: 我们今天一早乘火车越过了边境。

ex.en: Countries that share a border often need to cooperate closely on trade and environmental protection.
ex.zh: 接壤的国家往往需要在贸易和环境保护方面密切合作。

tip: border作动词直接接地点；border on还可表示近乎。

senses.en: an adult male animal of the cattle family
an investor who expects market prices to rise

ex.en: A large bull stood quietly beside the farm gate.
ex.zh: 一头大公牛静静地站在农场门旁。

ex.en: During a bull market, rising share prices may encourage households to invest more of their savings.
ex.zh: 在牛市期间，股价上涨可能促使家庭将更多储蓄用于投资。

col: take the bull by the horns
tip: 金融中bull指看涨者，与bear（看跌者）相对。

senses.en: Dishonest behaviour intended to gain an unfair advantage.

ex.en: Peeking at another player's cards is cheating, even among friends.
ex.zh: 即使是朋友一起玩，偷看别人的牌也算作弊。

ex.en: Schools can discourage cheating by designing assessments that reward independent thinking rather than the simple recall of facts.
ex.zh: 学校可以设计重视独立思考而非单纯记忆事实的考核，以减少作弊。

tip: cheating作行为名词通常不可数；cheat也可指作弊者。

senses.en: to have something inside or as a part
to prevent something from spreading or becoming stronger

ex.en: This small box contains all my sewing supplies.
ex.zh: 这个小盒子里装着我所有的缝纫用品。

ex.en: Processed foods often contain large amounts of salt, which can contribute to serious health problems.
ex.zh: 加工食品往往含有大量盐分，可能导致严重的健康问题。

tip: 及物动词，直接接宾语；表示“含有”时通常不用进行时。

senses.en: Becoming more economically advanced, often with improving living standards.
Growing or becoming more complete over time.

ex.en: My cousin builds water pumps in a developing country.
ex.zh: 我表亲在一个发展中国家修建水泵。

ex.en: Developing economies often need sustained investment in education and infrastructure to improve living standards.
ex.zh: 发展中经济体往往需要持续投资教育和基础设施，以提高生活水平。

tip: developing指发展中的；developed指已发展的、发达的。

senses.en: a building or shared room where students sleep

ex.en: My dorm is just five minutes from the library.
ex.zh: 我的宿舍离图书馆只有五分钟路程。

ex.en: Living in a dorm can help first-year students develop social skills and adjust to university life.
ex.zh: 住宿舍可以帮助大一学生培养社交技能，适应大学生活。

tip: dorm是dormitory的非正式简称，多见于美式英语。

senses.en: moving stairs that carry people between floors

ex.en: Hold the handrail while you ride the escalator upstairs.
ex.zh: 乘自动扶梯上楼时，请扶好扶手。

ex.en: Although escalators improve passenger flow in stations, lifts are essential for travellers who use wheelchairs.
ex.zh: 尽管自动扶梯能改善车站的客流通行情况，但对使用轮椅的旅客而言，电梯必不可少。

tip: escalator是自动扶梯；lift是厢式电梯。

senses.en: Often or many times

ex.en: Our neighbour frequently brings us vegetables from her garden.
ex.zh: 邻居经常给我们送来她园子里种的蔬菜。

ex.en: People who frequently use public transport may spend less on travel than those who drive daily.
ex.zh: 经常使用公共交通的人，出行开支可能低于每天开车的人。

tip: 通常放实义动词前、be动词后，与often近义。

senses.en: Completing a course of study, or the ceremony celebrating this.

ex.en: My sister wore a blue gown at her graduation.
ex.zh: 姐姐在毕业典礼上穿了一件蓝色学位袍。

ex.en: Universities should provide career guidance before graduation to help students make a successful transition into employment.
ex.zh: 大学应在学生毕业前提供职业指导，帮助他们顺利过渡到职场。

tip: 表示从某校毕业，动词用graduate from。

senses.zh: 有历史意义的；历史著名的
senses.en: Important in history or likely to be remembered in history.

ex.en: We crossed the historic bridge just before sunset.
ex.zh: 我们在日落前走过了那座历史名桥。

ex.en: Protecting historic buildings helps cities preserve their cultural identity while attracting visitors and supporting local businesses.
ex.zh: 保护历史建筑有助于城市保留文化特色，同时吸引游客并支持当地商业。

tip: historic强调历史意义；historical泛指与历史有关。

senses.en: a small cupboard for keeping personal belongings secure

ex.en: I left my trainers in a locker at the gym.
ex.zh: 我把运动鞋留在健身房的储物柜里了。

ex.en: Providing each student with a locker can reduce the weight of bags carried around school.
ex.zh: 为每位学生配备储物柜，可以减轻他们在校园内携带的书包重量。

tip: locker通常是存放个人物品的小柜，不指上锁的人。

senses.en: Sadness and concern for someone who is suffering.
Something disappointing or unfortunate.
To feel sorry for someone because of their difficulties.

ex.en: I felt pity for the puppy shivering in the rain.
ex.zh: 看到小狗在雨中发抖，我心生怜悯。

ex.en: It is a pity that many historic buildings are demolished before their cultural value is properly assessed.
ex.zh: 许多历史建筑的文化价值尚未得到充分评估就被拆除，实在令人遗憾。

tip: 表同情通常不可数；表遗憾常用a pity。

senses.en: to encourage something to develop or become more widely accepted
to give someone a higher position at work
to attract attention to something to increase interest or sales

ex.en: Our local club promotes cycling through free weekend rides.
ex.zh: 我们当地的俱乐部通过免费的周末骑行活动推广骑车。

ex.en: Schools can promote healthier lifestyles by providing nutritious meals and encouraging students to take regular exercise.
ex.zh: 学校可以通过提供营养餐并鼓励学生定期锻炼来倡导更健康的生活方式。

tip: 晋升到某职位用be promoted to＋职位。

senses.en: to become aware of a fact or understand a situation
to make a hope, ambition, or possibility become real

ex.en: I suddenly realised my keys were still inside the house.
ex.zh: 我突然意识到钥匙还在屋里。

ex.en: Many students realise the importance of time management when they begin balancing academic work with paid employment.
ex.zh: 许多学生开始兼顾学业与有偿工作时，才意识到时间管理的重要性。

tip: 英式常写realise，美式写realize；可接that从句。

senses.en: Showing good judgement and practical understanding.

ex.en: Taking an umbrella was sensible in this weather.
ex.zh: 这种天气带把伞是明智的。

ex.en: Investing in preventive healthcare is a sensible way to reduce pressure on public hospitals over time.
ex.zh: 投资预防性医疗是逐步减轻公立医院压力的明智之举。

tip: sensible指明智的；sensitive指敏感的。

senses.en: A strip of material wrapped around an injury for protection.
To wrap an injured body part in a bandage.

ex.en: The nurse wrapped a clean bandage around my ankle.
ex.zh: 护士用干净的绷带包住了我的脚踝。

ex.en: Basic first aid courses teach people how to apply a bandage safely before professional help arrives.
ex.zh: 基础急救课程教人们如何在专业救援到来前安全地使用绷带。

tip: 既是名词也是动词；bandage a wound意为包扎伤口。

senses.en: To lose blood from a wound or inside the body.

ex.en: My finger started to bleed after a small paper cut.
ex.zh: 我的手指被纸轻轻划了一下，开始流血了。

ex.en: First aid courses teach people how to respond safely when minor injuries cause someone to bleed.
ex.zh: 急救课程教人们在轻伤导致出血时如何安全应对。

tip: 过去式和过去分词均为bled；blood是名词“血”。

senses.en: A product that makes hair softer and easier to manage.
A liquid added during washing to make fabrics softer.

ex.en: I use conditioner to keep my curly hair soft.
ex.zh: 我用护发素让卷发保持柔软。

ex.en: Consumers can reduce plastic waste by choosing refillable containers for shampoo and conditioner products.
ex.zh: 消费者可以选择可补充装的洗发水和护发素容器，以减少塑料垃圾。

tip: 单独用常指护发素；空调要说air conditioner。

senses.en: to win against someone in a competition or conflict
an occasion when someone loses a competition or conflict
to prevent a plan or aim from succeeding

ex.en: Our team defeated the champions in a thrilling final.
ex.zh: 我们队在一场激动人心的决赛中击败了冠军队。

ex.en: Although electoral defeat can damage a political party, it may also encourage necessary changes in leadership and policy.
ex.zh: 尽管选举失利会对政党造成打击，但也可能促使其对领导层和政策作出必要调整。

tip: defeat后接对手；win后接比赛、奖项等。

senses.en: extremely large in size, amount, or degree

ex.en: An enormous pumpkin filled the basket on our kitchen table.
ex.zh: 一个巨大的南瓜占满了厨房桌上的篮子。

ex.en: Rapid urban growth places enormous pressure on housing, transport networks, and other essential public services.
ex.zh: 城市的快速发展给住房、交通网络及其他基本公共服务带来巨大压力。

tip: 既可形容体积，也可形容压力、数量或影响很大。

senses.en: Performances or activities that people enjoy watching or doing.

ex.en: The hotel provides live entertainment beside the pool every evening.
ex.zh: 酒店每晚都在泳池边提供现场娱乐表演。

ex.en: Affordable entertainment facilities can improve urban life by giving residents opportunities to relax and socialise.
ex.zh: 价格亲民的娱乐设施能让居民有机会放松和社交，从而改善城市生活。

tip: 通常不可数：提供娱乐用provide entertainment。

senses.en: able to live or act without relying on others
not controlled by another person, organisation, or country
not connected with or affected by something else

ex.en: Living alone has made me much more independent.
ex.zh: 独居让我变得更加独立。

ex.en: Independent research can help governments assess whether new environmental policies are achieving their intended goals.
ex.zh: 独立研究可以帮助政府评估新的环境政策是否正在实现预期目标。

tip: 常搭配of：independent of意为不依赖或不受影响。

senses.en: to put equipment or software in place for use
to formally place someone in an important position

ex.en: We hired an electrician to install the new ceiling fan.
ex.zh: 我们请了一位电工来安装新吊扇。

ex.en: Schools need sufficient funding to install reliable internet connections and maintain essential digital equipment.
ex.zh: 学校需要充足的资金来安装可靠的网络连接，并维护必要的数字设备。

tip: 下载是download；下载后安装才是install。

senses.en: A set of tools or equipment for a particular activity
A set of parts used to build something

ex.en: We keep a first aid kit in the car.
ex.zh: 我们在车里备有一个急救包。

ex.en: Schools should provide basic science kits so that all pupils can take part in practical experiments.
ex.zh: 学校应提供基础科学实验套件，让所有学生都能参与动手实验。

tip: kit指成套用品；kit sb out表示给某人配装备。

senses.en: The fact of no longer having someone or something.
Money lost when costs are higher than income.
A defeat in a game or competition.

ex.en: She reported the loss of her wallet yesterday.
ex.zh: 她昨天报失了钱包。

ex.en: The loss of natural habitats threatens biodiversity and can weaken ecosystems that support local agriculture.
ex.zh: 自然栖息地的丧失威胁生物多样性，也可能削弱支撑当地农业的生态系统。

tip: loss是名词，lose是动词，过去式和过去分词为lost。

senses.en: During the same time or while something else is happening.

ex.en: The soup is simmering; meanwhile, I will prepare dessert.
ex.zh: 汤正在慢炖；趁这会儿，我来准备甜点。

ex.en: New railway lines may take years to complete; meanwhile, cities should improve existing bus services.
ex.zh: 新铁路线可能需要多年才能建成；在此期间，城市应改善现有的公交服务。

tip: 连接两个完整句子时，前面用句号或分号。

senses.en: an imaginary creature that is large, strange, or frightening
a person who behaves in an extremely cruel way
extremely large in size or amount

ex.en: The friendly monster in the cartoon has purple feet.
ex.zh: 动画片里那只友善的怪物长着紫色的脚。

ex.en: Stories about monsters can help children explore their fears within a safe and imaginative setting.
ex.zh: 有关怪物的故事可以帮助儿童在安全且富有想象力的情境中探索自己的恐惧。

tip: 形容词用法较口语化，置于名词前表示巨大。

senses.en: material made of crossing threads with spaces between them
remaining after costs, taxes, or other amounts have been deducted
to earn as profit or successfully obtain something

ex.en: A small silver fish wriggled inside the fishing net.
ex.zh: 一条银色的小鱼在渔网里扭动。

ex.en: The company increased its net profit by reducing energy consumption rather than raising prices for customers.
ex.zh: 这家公司通过减少能源消耗而非提高售价来增加净利润。

tip: net指扣除成本或税款后的净额；gross指扣除前的总额。

senses.en: To some extent, but not completely.

ex.en: The path was partly covered with fallen leaves.
ex.zh: 小路上有一部分被落叶覆盖了。

ex.en: The rise in cycling is partly due to improved infrastructure and growing concern about air quality.
ex.zh: 骑自行车的人增多，部分原因是基础设施改善以及人们更加关注空气质量。

tip: 表示部分而非全部；常用partly because说明原因。

senses.en: The feeling of being unhappy, especially after loss or disappointment.

ex.en: She felt a deep sadness when her friend moved away.
ex.zh: 朋友搬走时，她感到深深的难过。

ex.en: Regular social contact can help reduce feelings of sadness among older people who live alone.
ex.zh: 经常与人交往有助于减轻独居老年人的悲伤情绪。

tip: 通常作不可数名词；a sense of sadness指一种悲伤感。

senses.en: Relating to the sun.
Using energy from sunlight to produce heat or electricity.

ex.en: We wore special protective glasses to watch the solar eclipse.
ex.zh: 我们戴着专用防护眼镜观看日食。

ex.en: Investment in solar energy can reduce dependence on fossil fuels and create jobs in rural communities.
ex.zh: 投资太阳能可以减少对化石燃料的依赖，并为农村社区创造就业机会。

tip: solar是形容词，常用于太阳或太阳能相关搭配。

senses.en: A land reptile with a hard shell and short legs.

ex.en: The tortoise slowly stretched its neck towards a lettuce leaf.
ex.zh: 陆龟慢慢伸长脖子，探向一片生菜叶。

ex.en: Protecting natural habitats is essential for tortoise populations threatened by illegal trade and agricultural expansion.
ex.zh: 保护自然栖息地对受到非法贸易和农业扩张威胁的陆龟种群至关重要。

tip: 通常指陆龟；英式英语中turtle多指海龟。

senses.en: Gold, jewels, or other highly valuable objects
Something greatly valued for its beauty, importance, or personal meaning
To value something deeply and care for it

ex.en: The children imagined finding treasure inside the old chest.
ex.zh: 孩子们想象着在旧箱子里发现财宝。

ex.en: Museums preserve cultural treasures so that future generations can understand the achievements and traditions of earlier societies.
ex.zh: 博物馆保存文化珍宝，让后代能够了解早期社会的成就和传统。

tip: 泛指财宝时不可数；指具体珍品时可数。

senses.en: a large sea fish, or its flesh eaten as food

ex.en: I made a tuna sandwich for lunch today.
ex.zh: 我今天做了一个金枪鱼三明治当午餐。

ex.en: International cooperation is essential to prevent overfishing and ensure that tuna populations remain healthy for future generations.
ex.zh: 国际合作对于防止过度捕捞、确保金枪鱼种群为后代保持健康至关重要。

tip: 指鱼肉时不可数；指鱼时复数通常仍为tuna。

senses.en: a traditional or usual way of behaving
made to meet a particular customer's needs
the business customers give to a shop or company

ex.en: Sharing a meal is an important custom in our family.
ex.zh: 一起吃饭是我们家的一项重要惯例。

ex.en: Schools can introduce children to local customs while encouraging respect for traditions from other cultures.
ex.zh: 学校可以向孩子们介绍当地风俗，同时鼓励他们尊重其他文化的传统。

tip: custom指风俗或惯例；customs还可指海关。

senses.en: A large hunting bird with powerful claws and sharp eyesight

ex.en: An eagle circled slowly above the rocky valley.
ex.zh: 一只鹰在岩石遍布的山谷上方缓缓盘旋。

ex.en: Protecting mountain forests helps preserve the hunting grounds and nesting sites of the eagle.
ex.zh: 保护山地森林有助于保全鹰的猎食区和筑巢地。

tip: eagle通常指大型猛禽；eagle-eyed形容眼力敏锐。

senses.en: the system of producing, trading, and using goods and services
careful use of money, time, or resources to avoid waste

ex.en: Tourists support the local economy by shopping here.
ex.zh: 游客在这里购物，为当地经济提供支持。

ex.en: Investing in renewable energy can strengthen the economy while reducing dependence on imported fuels.
ex.zh: 投资可再生能源可以增强经济实力，同时减少对进口燃料的依赖。

tip: economic指经济的；economical指节省的、划算的。

senses.en: Someone who supports a person, belief, or movement
Someone who subscribes to another user's social media updates

ex.en: My uncle is a devoted follower of the local team.
ex.zh: 我叔叔是本地球队的忠实拥护者。

ex.en: Having many followers on social media does not necessarily make someone a reliable source of health advice.
ex.zh: 在社交媒体上拥有众多关注者，并不一定意味着一个人能提供可靠的健康建议。

tip: 表示追随者或账号关注者，不一定是狂热粉丝。

senses.en: Kind and careful, without roughness or force.
Mild in strength, movement, or effect.
Rising or falling gradually rather than steeply.

ex.en: Be gentle when you pick up the little kitten.
ex.zh: 抱起那只小猫时，动作要轻柔。

ex.en: Gentle exercise, such as walking or swimming, can improve physical health without placing excessive strain on joints.
ex.zh: 散步或游泳等温和运动可以改善身体健康，又不会给关节带来过大负担。

tip: 对人温柔用be gentle with sb。

senses.en: a person whose job is to protect people or places
to protect someone or something from danger or escape
a cover or barrier that prevents injury or damage

ex.en: The guard checked my ticket before opening the gate.
ex.zh: 警卫检查了我的票才打开大门。

ex.en: Museums employ trained staff to guard valuable collections while ensuring that visitors can enjoy them safely.
ex.zh: 博物馆雇用受过培训的工作人员保护珍贵藏品，同时确保游客能够安全地观赏。

tip: guard against表示防范某种风险或错误。

senses.en: A passage inside a building or space by its entrance

ex.en: Please leave your muddy boots in the hallway.
ex.zh: 请把沾满泥的靴子留在门厅里。

ex.en: Wide hallways and accessible entrances make public buildings easier to navigate for people with limited mobility.
ex.zh: 宽敞的走廊和无障碍入口让行动不便的人更容易在公共建筑内通行。

tip: 既可指入口门厅，也可指连接房间的走廊。

senses.en: Used to confirm something or emphasize that it is true.
Used to add information that strengthens a previous statement.

ex.en: The soup was very tasty indeed, so I had more.
ex.zh: 这汤确实非常好喝，所以我又喝了一些。

ex.en: Public transport can reduce congestion; indeed, reliable bus services may persuade many commuters to stop driving.
ex.zh: 公共交通能够缓解拥堵；事实上，可靠的公交服务可能使许多通勤者放弃开车。

tip: 可用very＋形容词＋indeed加强语气。

senses.en: A narrow boat moved with a paddle having two blades.
To travel across water in a kayak.

ex.en: She paddled her kayak gently across the quiet lake.
ex.zh: 她轻轻划着皮艇穿过平静的湖面。

ex.en: Exploring coastal areas by kayak allows tourists to enjoy natural scenery without producing engine noise.
ex.zh: 乘皮艇探索沿海地区，让游客能在不产生发动机噪声的情况下欣赏自然风光。

tip: kayak通常用双叶桨；canoe通常用单叶桨。

senses.en: Soft, wet earth made when soil mixes with water.

ex.en: Our boots were covered in mud after the walk.
ex.zh: 散步回来后，我们的靴子上沾满了泥。

ex.en: Heavy rainfall can turn unpaved roads into mud, making rural communities difficult to reach.
ex.zh: 强降雨会使未铺装的道路变得泥泞，导致农村社区交通不便。

tip: mud通常不可数；形容泥泞用muddy。

senses.en: Cloth or paper used to wipe your mouth while eating

ex.en: He wiped the soup from his chin with a napkin.
ex.zh: 他用餐巾擦掉下巴上的汤。

ex.en: Restaurants can reduce waste by replacing disposable paper napkins with reusable cloth alternatives, provided laundering is managed efficiently.
ex.zh: 只要高效安排洗涤，餐馆就能用可重复使用的布餐巾替代一次性餐巾纸来减少垃圾。

tip: 现代常指餐巾；“尿布”英式通常用nappy。

senses.en: to entertain an audience by acting, singing, or playing music
to carry out a task, action, or duty
to work or achieve results in a particular way

ex.en: Our choir will perform at the community centre tonight.
ex.zh: 我们的合唱团今晚将在社区中心演出。

ex.en: Students often perform better academically when schools provide regular feedback and access to individual support.
ex.zh: 学校提供定期反馈和个别支持时，学生的学业表现往往更好。

tip: 既可指表演，也可接task、duty表示执行。

senses.en: A hollow tube that carries liquid or gas.
To carry liquid or gas through pipes.
A small bowl with a tube used for smoking tobacco.

ex.en: Water dripped from a broken pipe under the sink.
ex.zh: 水从洗涤槽下面一根破裂的管子里滴下来。

ex.en: Replacing damaged water pipes can help cities conserve resources and ensure a reliable supply of clean drinking water.
ex.zh: 更换受损水管可以帮助城市节约资源，并确保清洁饮用水的可靠供应。

tip: pipe可作动词：pipe water to把水输送到某处。

senses.en: To take money or property illegally from someone or somewhere.
To unfairly take away something valuable or important.

ex.en: Someone tried to rob the shop near our house.
ex.zh: 有人试图抢劫我们家附近的商店。

ex.en: Long working hours can rob parents of valuable opportunities to spend time with their children.
ex.zh: 过长的工作时间可能使父母失去与孩子共度时光的宝贵机会。

tip: rob接人或地点；steal接被偷的物品。

senses.en: A tool used to turn screws into or out of objects.

ex.en: Pass me the screwdriver so I can tighten this handle.
ex.zh: 把螺丝刀递给我，我来把这个把手拧紧。

ex.en: Teaching students to use basic tools, such as a screwdriver, can encourage practical skills and greater independence.
ex.zh: 教学生使用螺丝刀等基本工具，可以培养动手能力并增强独立性。

tip: screw是螺丝；screwdriver是拧螺丝的工具。

senses.en: To remove hair from skin using a razor.
To remove thin pieces or reduce something by a small amount.
An act of removing facial hair with a razor.

ex.en: I shave every morning before leaving for work.
ex.zh: 我每天早晨出门上班前都会刮胡子。

ex.en: Improved transport connections could shave several minutes off daily journeys and encourage more people to commute by train.
ex.zh: 改善交通衔接可以缩短几分钟的日常行程，并鼓励更多人乘火车通勤。

tip: 过去式shaved；过去分词shaved或shaven。

senses.en: To suddenly force air out through your nose and mouth.
A sudden, involuntary burst of air from the nose and mouth.

ex.en: Dust from the old rug made me sneeze.
ex.zh: 旧地毯扬起的灰尘让我打了喷嚏。

ex.en: Covering your mouth and nose when you sneeze helps reduce the spread of respiratory infections.
ex.zh: 打喷嚏时遮住口鼻有助于减少呼吸道感染的传播。

tip: 动词不及物；“打一个喷嚏”可说give a sneeze。

senses.en: An exciting story or film involving danger, suspense, or crime.

ex.en: We watched a thriller and kept guessing the ending.
ex.zh: 我们看了一部惊悚片，一直在猜结局。

ex.en: A well-made thriller can encourage audiences to consider ethical questions while maintaining a strong sense of suspense.
ex.zh: 制作精良的惊悚片能在保持强烈悬念的同时，引导观众思考伦理问题。

tip: thriller重悬念与紧张感，不等于恐怖片。

senses.en: The process of expressing meaning in another language.
A spoken or written version in another language.

ex.en: This translation of the story is easy to understand.
ex.zh: 这个故事的译文很容易理解。

ex.en: Accurate translation allows researchers from different countries to share findings and collaborate more effectively.
ex.zh: 准确的翻译使不同国家的研究人员能够分享研究结果，并更有效地合作。

tip: 翻译成某语言用into；从某语言翻译用from。

senses.en: to draw a line beneath a word or phrase
to show that something is especially important

ex.en: Our teacher asked us to underline the unfamiliar words.
ex.zh: 老师让我们在不熟悉的单词下面画线。

ex.en: These findings underline the importance of providing affordable housing near public transport for families on low incomes.
ex.zh: 这些发现凸显了在公共交通附近为低收入家庭提供可负担住房的重要性。

tip: 本义是在下方画线，也常用于强调重要性。

senses.en: Causing discomfort, dislike, or unhappiness.
Behaving in an unfriendly or rude way.

ex.en: An unpleasant smell was coming from the kitchen bin.
ex.zh: 厨房垃圾桶里散发出一股难闻的气味。

ex.en: Although commuting can be unpleasant, reliable public transport can reduce stress and improve the daily experience of workers.
ex.zh: 虽然通勤可能令人不快，但可靠的公共交通能减轻压力，改善上班族的日常体验。

tip: 形容事物表示令人不快；形容人常指态度不友善。

senses.en: To say you are sorry for something you have done.

ex.en: I should apologise for spilling juice on your jacket.
ex.zh: 我把果汁洒在了你的夹克上，应该向你道歉。

ex.en: Companies should apologise publicly when their mistakes cause inconvenience or financial loss to customers.
ex.zh: 当企业的失误给顾客造成不便或经济损失时，企业应该公开道歉。

tip: 英式拼写；美式常用apologize，后接to人、for事。

senses.en: Willing to face danger or difficulty despite feeling afraid.
To face something dangerous or unpleasant with courage.

ex.en: You were brave to speak in front of everyone.
ex.zh: 你敢在大家面前发言，真勇敢。

ex.en: It takes brave leadership to introduce necessary environmental reforms when powerful groups strongly oppose them.
ex.zh: 当强势群体激烈反对时，推行必要的环境改革需要勇敢的领导力。

tip: brave并非毫不害怕，而是害怕仍敢面对。

senses.en: someone whose job involves records, documents, or routine office tasks
someone serving customers in a shop or at a desk

ex.en: The clerk checked my details and handed me a form.
ex.zh: 办事员核对了我的资料，递给我一张表格。

ex.en: Although digital services are expanding, many residents still prefer discussing complex applications with a trained clerk.
ex.zh: 尽管数字服务不断扩展，许多居民仍更愿意向受过培训的办事员咨询复杂的申请事项。

tip: 英式读音中元音为/ɑː/；美式常指店员。

senses.en: A place providing medical advice or treatment without overnight stays.

ex.en: The clinic near our house opens early on weekdays.
ex.zh: 我们家附近的诊所工作日很早就开门。

ex.en: Local clinics can reduce pressure on hospitals by treating common illnesses and providing preventive care.
ex.zh: 当地诊所可以通过治疗常见病和提供预防性保健来减轻医院的压力。

tip: clinic指诊所或门诊部；“临床的”用clinical。

senses.en: To have earned something because of your actions or qualities.

ex.en: You deserve a rest after carrying those heavy boxes.
ex.zh: 搬了那些沉重的箱子后，你该休息一下了。

ex.en: Healthcare workers deserve greater recognition because their dedication contributes directly to the wellbeing of society.
ex.zh: 医护人员值得获得更多认可，因为他们的奉献直接促进了社会福祉。

tip: 接名词或to do；不用deserve doing表示主动。

senses.en: Pay someone to work for you.
Use a method, skill, or resource for a purpose.

ex.en: The bakery employs three people from our neighbourhood.
ex.zh: 这家面包店雇用了我们街区的三个人。

ex.en: Teachers can employ a range of practical activities to help students understand complex scientific concepts.
ex.zh: 教师可以采用一系列实践活动，帮助学生理解复杂的科学概念。

tip: employ既可指雇人，也可正式地表示采用方法。

senses.en: A wild animal with pointed ears and a bushy tail.
To confuse someone or make a problem difficult to solve.

ex.en: A fox slipped through the garden before sunrise.
ex.zh: 日出前，一只狐狸悄悄穿过花园。

ex.en: The red fox can adapt to urban environments where food is readily available from human activity.
ex.zh: 赤狐能够适应城市环境，因为人类活动使食物很容易获取。

tip: 作动词表示“难倒”，主要用于英式非正式语境。

senses.en: An increase in size, amount, or level.
The process of growing physically or developing over time.
An unusual lump of tissue growing in or on the body.

ex.en: The rapid growth of our town surprised my grandparents.
ex.zh: 我们小镇的迅速扩张让我的祖父母感到惊讶。

ex.en: Governments should balance economic growth with environmental protection to ensure that rising prosperity does not exhaust natural resources.
ex.zh: 政府应平衡经济增长与环境保护，确保日益繁荣的经济不会耗尽自然资源。

tip: 表示增长通常不可数；a growth可指一个肿块。

senses.en: The quality of being funny or the ability to appreciate funniness.
A person's mood or state of mind.
To agree with someone's wishes to keep them happy.

ex.en: Her gentle humour made everyone at dinner feel relaxed.
ex.zh: 她温和的幽默让晚餐时的每个人都放松了下来。

ex.en: Teachers can use humour to reduce classroom anxiety and encourage students to participate more confidently.
ex.zh: 教师可以利用幽默缓解课堂焦虑，鼓励学生更自信地参与。

tip: 英式拼写humour，美式humor；作动词表示迁就。

senses.en: Not allowed by law

ex.en: It is illegal to park here overnight without permission.
ex.zh: 未经许可在这里通宵停车是违法的。

ex.en: Stronger international cooperation is needed to prevent illegal fishing and protect vulnerable marine ecosystems.
ex.zh: 需要加强国际合作，以防止非法捕捞并保护脆弱的海洋生态系统。

tip: 常用句型：It is illegal to do sth.。

senses.en: a comfortable room for sitting, relaxing, or waiting
a room in a home for sitting and relaxing
to sit or lie in a relaxed, lazy way

ex.en: We waited in the lounge until our room was ready.
ex.zh: 我们在休息室等候，直到房间准备好。

ex.en: Comfortable airport lounges can make long journeys less stressful for passengers travelling with young children.
ex.zh: 舒适的机场休息室可以减轻带幼儿出行的旅客在长途旅行中的压力。

tip: 英式英语中可指家中客厅；作动词常接 around。

senses.en: Used with to for advice, duty, or the right action.
Used with to to express what is likely or expected.

ex.en: You ought to take an umbrella; those clouds look dark.
ex.zh: 你应该带把伞，那些云看起来很阴沉。

ex.en: Governments ought to ensure that all children have access to quality education, regardless of family income.
ex.zh: 政府应确保所有儿童都能接受优质教育，不受家庭收入影响。

tip: ought是情态动词，后接to do；否定为ought not to。

senses.en: an object wrapped for sending by post or delivery
a piece of land considered as a single unit
to wrap something, or divide it into portions for distribution

ex.en: A small parcel arrived for you this morning.
ex.zh: 今天早上有个寄给你的小包裹到了。

ex.en: The growing volume of parcel deliveries has encouraged cities to explore cleaner transport options for local distribution.
ex.zh: 包裹配送量不断增长，促使城市探索更环保的本地配送方式。

tip: 包裹在英式英语中常用parcel，美式英语更常用package。

senses.en: a flightless seabird with black and white feathers, found mainly south

ex.en: The penguin waddled across the rocks towards the sea.
ex.zh: 那只企鹅摇摇摆摆地走过岩石，朝大海走去。

ex.en: Changes in ocean temperatures can affect penguin populations by altering the availability of fish and other prey.
ex.zh: 海水温度的变化会改变鱼类及其他猎物的供应量，从而影响企鹅种群。

tip: 企鹅是不会飞的鸟；并非全都生活在南极。

senses.en: Fair and sensible, showing good judgement.
Not too expensive.
Acceptable in quality or amount, though not excellent.

ex.en: Your suggestion sounds reasonable, so let's try it tomorrow.
ex.zh: 你的建议听起来很合理，我们明天试试吧。

ex.en: Employers should set reasonable targets that encourage productivity without placing excessive pressure on their staff.
ex.zh: 雇主应设定合理目标，在提高生产效率的同时避免给员工施加过大压力。

tip: 形容价格时指公道、不贵，不一定是非常便宜。

senses.en: Rest or enjoyable activity that reduces stress and tension.
The process of muscles becoming less tight.
The act of making rules or restrictions less strict.

ex.en: After work, I enjoy a warm bath for relaxation.
ex.zh: 下班后，我喜欢泡个热水澡放松一下。

ex.en: Schools should teach relaxation techniques to help students manage anxiety before important examinations.
ex.zh: 学校应教授放松技巧，帮助学生缓解重要考试前的焦虑。

tip: 表示放松、休息时通常不可数：for relaxation。

senses.en: The natural features of a place considered for their beauty.
Painted backgrounds and structures that create a play's setting.

ex.en: We stopped by the lake to admire the scenery.
ex.zh: 我们在湖边停下来欣赏风景。

ex.en: Protecting natural scenery can attract responsible tourism while preserving valuable habitats for local wildlife.
ex.zh: 保护自然风景可以吸引负责任的旅游活动，同时为当地野生动物保留宝贵的栖息地。

tip: scenery是不可数名词，不说a scenery或sceneries。

senses.en: Caring about your own needs without considering other people

ex.en: It was selfish to take the whole cake.
ex.zh: 把整个蛋糕拿走太自私了。

ex.en: Selfish behaviour in shared housing can create tension and undermine trust among residents over time.
ex.zh: 合租住房中的自私行为会造成矛盾，并逐渐损害住户之间的信任。

tip: 评价某人的行为用It is selfish of sb to do。

senses.en: Apart from others, or individually rather than together.

ex.en: We paid separately, then walked home together after lunch.
ex.zh: 我们午饭后分别付了账，然后一起走回家。

ex.en: Households should collect food waste separately so that local authorities can process it into compost more efficiently.
ex.zh: 家庭应将厨余垃圾单独收集，以便地方政府更高效地将其制成堆肥。

tip: 与某物分开用separately from，不用with。

senses.en: A vegetable with dark green leaves eaten raw or cooked.

ex.en: I added fresh spinach to the soup before dinner.
ex.zh: 晚饭前，我往汤里加了新鲜菠菜。

ex.en: Leafy vegetables such as spinach provide nutrients that support a healthy, balanced diet.
ex.zh: 菠菜等绿叶蔬菜提供的营养有助于构建健康、均衡的饮食。

tip: 通常不可数；一片菠菜叶说a spinach leaf。

senses.en: as a result of what has just been stated

ex.en: The shop was closed; therefore, we went home empty-handed.
ex.zh: 商店关门了，因此我们空手回了家。

ex.en: Public parks encourage physical activity and social interaction; therefore, cities should invest in maintaining accessible green spaces.
ex.zh: 公共公园有助于促进体育活动和社交互动，因此城市应投入资金维护方便使用的绿地。

tip: 是副词，不能仅用逗号连接两个完整句子。

senses.en: Happening without being expected or predicted.

ex.en: An unexpected visitor arrived just as we finished lunch.
ex.zh: 我们刚吃完午饭，一位意想不到的客人就来了。

ex.en: Governments need emergency funds to manage unexpected events without reducing essential spending on healthcare and education.
ex.zh: 政府需要应急资金来应对意外事件，避免削减医疗和教育方面的必要支出。

tip: unexpected强调未料到，不一定表示突然发生。

senses.en: take things out of a bag, box, or other container
examine an idea carefully to explain its different parts

ex.en: I unpacked my suitcase and hung up my shirts.
ex.zh: 我把衣物从行李箱里拿出来，挂好了衬衫。

ex.en: Teachers can help students unpack complex arguments by examining the evidence and assumptions behind each claim.
ex.zh: 教师可以通过审视每个论点背后的证据和假设，帮助学生剖析复杂的论证。

tip: 既可指取出行李，也可比喻拆解复杂观点。

senses.en: a word modifying a verb, adjective, adverb, or whole sentence

ex.en: Our teacher asked us to circle every adverb.
ex.zh: 老师让我们把每个副词都圈出来。

ex.en: Understanding how an adverb changes emphasis can help language learners express their opinions more precisely.
ex.zh: 理解副词如何改变强调重点，可以帮助语言学习者更准确地表达观点。

tip: adverb是名词；表示“副词的”用adverbial。

senses.en: Tell someone what you think they should do
Officially give someone information about something

ex.en: The doctor advised me to rest for a few days.
ex.zh: 医生建议我休息几天。

ex.en: Schools should advise students on career options before they choose subjects for further study.
ex.zh: 学校应在学生选择进修科目之前，就职业选择向他们提供建议。

tip: advise是动词；advice是不可数名词，词尾发/s/。

senses.en: feeling guilty or embarrassed about something wrong or disappointing
unwilling to do something because it feels embarrassing

ex.en: I felt ashamed after laughing at my friend's mistake.
ex.zh: 嘲笑朋友的错误后，我感到很羞愧。

ex.en: Students should never feel ashamed to ask for help when they struggle with difficult subjects.
ex.zh: 学生在学习较难的科目遇到困难时，绝不应因求助而感到难堪。

tip: 常作表语：be ashamed of或be ashamed to do。

senses.en: an artificial waterway for boats or carrying water
a narrow passage inside the body

ex.en: We watched a narrow boat glide along the canal.
ex.zh: 我们看着一艘窄船沿运河缓缓驶过。

ex.en: Restoring historic canals can attract tourists while providing valuable habitats for wildlife in densely populated urban areas.
ex.zh: 修复历史悠久的运河既能吸引游客，也能为人口密集城区的野生动物提供宝贵的栖息地。

tip: canal通常为人工水道；river指天然河流。

senses.en: Thick, stiff paper used for boxes and packaging

ex.en: We cut the cardboard into shapes for a model house.
ex.zh: 我们把硬纸板剪成各种形状，用来制作房屋模型。

ex.en: Replacing plastic packaging with recycled cardboard can reduce waste and encourage more sustainable consumption.
ex.zh: 用再生硬纸板替代塑料包装可以减少废弃物，并促进更可持续的消费。

tip: 通常不可数；一张硬纸板说a sheet of cardboard。

senses.en: Feeling or showing happiness and a positive attitude.
Making a place or experience feel bright and pleasant.

ex.en: Our cheerful neighbour waved as we left the house.
ex.zh: 我们出门时，开朗的邻居向我们挥了挥手。

ex.en: A cheerful classroom atmosphere can encourage younger learners to participate more actively in group discussions.
ex.zh: 愉快的课堂氛围能鼓励年幼的学习者更积极地参与小组讨论。

tip: 既可形容人心情开朗，也可形容环境明快。

senses.en: funny or connected with comedy
a publication telling stories through sequences of pictures
a performer who entertains people by making them laugh

ex.en: His comic dance had everyone laughing at the party.
ex.zh: 他那滑稽的舞蹈逗得聚会上的每个人都笑了。

ex.en: Comic characters can make educational programmes more engaging and help children remember important information.
ex.zh: 滑稽的角色可以让教育节目更有吸引力，帮助儿童记住重要信息。

tip: comic可指喜剧相关；comical侧重滑稽可笑。

senses.en: one of the Earth's main large areas of land

ex.en: Our teacher pointed to the African continent on a globe.
ex.zh: 老师指着地球仪上的非洲大陆。

ex.en: Climate change affects every continent, although its consequences vary considerably between regions and communities.
ex.zh: 气候变化影响每一个洲，但其后果因地区和群体而有很大差异。

tip: continent是洲或大陆，country是国家。

senses.en: The authority or place checking goods entering a country
Taxes charged on goods brought into a country
Traditional practices shared by a community or social group

ex.en: We opened our suitcases for inspection at customs.
ex.zh: 我们在海关打开行李箱接受检查。

ex.en: More efficient customs procedures can reduce delays at borders and support international trade without weakening security.
ex.zh: 更高效的海关程序可以减少边境延误，在不削弱安全保障的情况下促进国际贸易。

tip: 表示海关时保留词尾s；custom单数不表示海关。

senses.en: a very hard mineral used in jewellery and cutting tools
a shape with four equal sides and opposite angles equal

ex.en: A tiny diamond sparkled on her silver ring.
ex.zh: 她的银戒指上，一颗小钻石闪闪发光。

ex.en: The diamond industry faces growing pressure to demonstrate that its mining practices protect workers and local ecosystems.
ex.zh: 钻石行业面临越来越大的压力，需要证明其采矿活动能够保护工人和当地生态系统。

tip: diamond指金刚石或钻石；菱形的几何术语是rhombus。

senses.en: To be unlike something else in one or more ways.
To have a different opinion from another person.

ex.en: These jackets differ in price, but both look great.
ex.zh: 这两件夹克价格不同，但都很好看。

ex.en: Educational priorities differ between countries because economic conditions and cultural expectations shape national policies.
ex.zh: 各国的教育重点有所不同，因为经济条件和文化期待会影响国家政策。

tip: from引出比较对象，in引出差异方面。

senses.en: A person from a country other than the one being discussed.

ex.en: As a foreigner, I needed help understanding local customs.
ex.zh: 作为外国人，我需要别人帮助我了解当地习俗。

ex.en: Language courses can help foreigners participate more fully in community life and access essential public services.
ex.zh: 语言课程可以帮助外国人更充分地参与社区生活，并获得必要的公共服务。

tip: 泛指外国人；特指游客时用visitor更自然。

senses.en: The study of shapes, angles, sizes, and spatial relationships.

ex.en: We used colourful wooden shapes in geometry class today.
ex.zh: 今天的几何课上，我们使用了彩色的木制图形。

ex.en: Learning geometry helps students develop spatial reasoning skills that are valuable in engineering and architecture.
ex.zh: 学习几何有助于学生培养空间推理能力，这种能力在工程和建筑领域很有价值。

tip: 学科名，不可数；通常不加冠词。

senses.en: The spirit of a dead person, imagined as appearing alive.
A very slight trace of a feeling, expression, or quality.

ex.en: My little cousin dressed as a ghost for the party.
ex.zh: 我的小表弟打扮成幽灵去参加派对。

ex.en: Local ghost stories can attract tourists while revealing how communities interpret their history and cultural traditions.
ex.zh: 当地的鬼故事可以吸引游客，也能反映社区如何理解自身历史与文化传统。

tip: a ghost of a smile指一丝若有若无的笑。

senses.en: A large waterbird with a long neck and webbed feet.
Meat from a goose, eaten as food.

ex.en: A white goose waddled across the path towards us.
ex.zh: 一只白鹅摇摇摆摆地穿过小路，朝我们走来。

ex.en: Protecting wetlands provides essential feeding grounds for wild geese and many other migratory birds.
ex.zh: 保护湿地能为野鹅及许多其他候鸟提供重要的觅食地。

tip: 复数为geese；表示鹅肉时不可数。

senses.en: someone admired for courage, achievements, or good actions
the main male character in a story

ex.en: The firefighter became a local hero after the rescue.
ex.zh: 那次救援后，这位消防员成了当地的英雄。

ex.en: Films often portray the hero as an exceptional individual, although real social progress usually requires collective effort.
ex.zh: 电影常把主人公塑造成非凡的个人，然而真正的社会进步通常需要集体努力。

tip: 复数为heroes；故事中的hero不一定品德高尚。

senses.en: A vehicle with several passenger seats, often used by families.
A small van used for transporting goods.

ex.en: Our minivan has enough seats for the whole family.
ex.zh: 我们的小型多座客车有足够的座位，可以坐下全家人。

ex.en: Shared minivan services can improve access to healthcare for rural residents who lack reliable public transport.
ex.zh: 共享小型客车服务可以帮助缺乏可靠公共交通的农村居民更方便地就医。

tip: 美式常指家庭多座客车，不宜一律译为小货车。

senses.en: the armed force that operates mainly at sea
a very dark blue colour
having a very dark blue colour

ex.en: My uncle joined the navy after leaving school.
ex.zh: 我叔叔毕业后加入了海军。

ex.en: The navy can support coastal communities by delivering emergency supplies after severe storms damage local roads.
ex.zh: 强风暴破坏当地道路后，海军可以运送应急物资，支援沿海社区。

tip: navy指海军整体；具体的一艘军舰用warship。

senses.en: The activity or skill of taking photographs.

ex.en: My sister enjoys photography and carries her camera everywhere.
ex.zh: 我姐姐喜欢摄影，走到哪儿都带着相机。

ex.en: Digital photography allows researchers to document environmental changes and share visual evidence with a wider audience.
ex.zh: 数码摄影让研究人员能够记录环境变化，并向更广泛的受众分享影像证据。

tip: photography不可数；一张照片用a photograph。

senses.en: A literary work using carefully arranged language, often in lines.

ex.en: Leila read a short poem aloud after dinner.
ex.zh: 莱拉晚饭后朗读了一首短诗。

ex.en: Reading a poem from another culture can help students explore unfamiliar perspectives and develop sensitivity to language.
ex.zh: 阅读来自另一种文化的诗歌，可以帮助学生探索陌生的视角，培养语言敏感度。

tip: poem可数，指一首诗；poetry不可数，统称诗歌。

senses.en: A horse of a small breed.

ex.en: The little pony gently ate a carrot from my hand.
ex.zh: 那匹小矮种马轻轻地吃着我手里的胡萝卜。

ex.en: Supervised pony riding can help children develop confidence while teaching them how to care responsibly for animals.
ex.zh: 在指导下骑矮种马可以帮助儿童建立信心，同时教会他们负责任地照顾动物。

tip: pony指小型品种的马；幼马是foal。

senses.en: not cooked
in its original state before processing or analysis
sore because the skin is damaged or irritated

ex.en: I prefer raw carrots because they are so crunchy.
ex.zh: 我更喜欢生胡萝卜，因为吃起来很脆。

ex.en: Countries that export mainly raw materials may be vulnerable to sudden changes in global commodity prices.
ex.zh: 主要出口原材料的国家可能容易受到全球大宗商品价格骤变的冲击。

tip: raw强调未烹煮或未加工，不等于“新鲜的”fresh。

senses.en: a loving relationship or the excitement and affection surrounding love
a story or film mainly about love

ex.en: Their romance began during a walking holiday in the mountains.
ex.zh: 他们的恋情始于一次山间徒步假期。

ex.en: Popular films often portray romance in idealised ways, which may shape young people's expectations of relationships.
ex.zh: 流行电影常以理想化的方式描绘爱情，这可能影响年轻人对恋爱关系的期待。

tip: 泛指爱情常不可数；指一段恋情或一部作品可数。

senses.en: A brass musical instrument with three valves and a bright sound.
To announce or praise something loudly and publicly.
To make a loud sound like an elephant's call.

ex.en: The musician lifted her trumpet and played a cheerful tune.
ex.zh: 那位乐手举起小号，吹奏了一支欢快的曲子。

ex.en: Learning the trumpet in a school orchestra can improve students' concentration and ability to cooperate with others.
ex.zh: 在学校管弦乐队学习小号可以提升学生的专注力及与他人合作的能力。

tip: 乐器义是“小号”；动词可指大肆宣扬。

senses.en: Clothes worn next to the skin beneath other clothes.

ex.en: I packed clean underwear in my travel bag.
ex.zh: 我把干净的内衣装进了旅行包。

ex.en: Consumers increasingly prefer underwear made from breathable fabrics, encouraging manufacturers to improve comfort and durability.
ex.zh: 消费者越来越偏爱透气面料制成的内衣，这促使制造商提升舒适度和耐用性。

tip: 不可数名词，不说an underwear或underwears。

senses.en: Low land between hills or mountains, often containing a river.

ex.en: A narrow river winds through the green valley.
ex.zh: 一条狭窄的河流蜿蜒穿过翠绿的山谷。

ex.en: Farming communities in the valley depend on seasonal rainfall to maintain their crops and support local livelihoods.
ex.zh: 河谷中的农业社区依靠季节性降雨维持作物生长，保障当地居民的生计。

tip: valley是两侧山地之间的低地，不等同于盆地basin。

senses.en: To promote products, services or events through public messages.
To announce publicly that someone or something is wanted.

ex.en: The bakery advertises its fresh bread on local radio.
ex.zh: 这家面包店在当地电台为自家的新鲜面包做广告。

ex.en: Governments should restrict how companies advertise sugary snacks to children, who may not recognise persuasive marketing techniques.
ex.zh: 政府应限制企业向儿童宣传高糖零食的方式，因为儿童可能无法识别具有诱导性的营销手法。

tip: advertise产品指宣传；advertise for人指登广告招聘。

senses.en: Someone whose job is to design buildings
Someone who plans and develops an important change or project

ex.en: The architect showed us a model of our future home.
ex.zh: 建筑师给我们看了未来新家的模型。

ex.en: Architects can reduce energy consumption by designing buildings that make better use of natural light.
ex.zh: 建筑师可以通过设计更充分利用自然光的建筑来降低能耗。

col: 首席建筑师；主要设计者
tip: architect指人，architecture指建筑学或建筑风格。

senses.en: A person trained to compete in sports requiring physical skill.

ex.en: The athlete stretched her legs before the morning race.
ex.zh: 那位运动员在早上的比赛前伸展了双腿。

ex.en: Young athletes need balanced training programmes that protect their health while allowing them to pursue sporting excellence.
ex.zh: 年轻运动员需要均衡的训练计划，在追求卓越运动表现的同时保护健康。

tip: athlete常泛指运动员，不只指田径选手。

senses.en: one thousand million
an extremely large quantity, usually expressed as billions

ex.en: The science museum displayed a rock a billion years old.
ex.zh: 科学博物馆展出了一块有十亿年历史的岩石。

ex.en: Governments spend billions of dollars on transport infrastructure to support economic growth and connect isolated communities.
ex.zh: 各国政府投入数十亿美元建设交通基础设施，以促进经济增长并连接偏远社区。

tip: 具体数值后不加s；泛指数十亿用billions of。

senses.en: Lasting a short time or using few words.
To give someone essential information or instructions.
Instructions explaining what a task should achieve.

ex.en: We took a brief break before finishing the puzzle.
ex.zh: 我们短暂休息了一下，然后完成了拼图。

ex.en: Teachers should brief students on safety procedures before allowing them to conduct experiments independently.
ex.zh: 教师应先向学生介绍安全操作规程，再允许他们独立进行实验。

tip: brief指时间短或内容简洁，本身不表示草率。

senses.en: a person or team that wins a competition
someone who strongly supports a cause or group
to actively support or defend a cause or person

ex.en: The new champion lifted her trophy with both hands.
ex.zh: 新冠军双手举起了奖杯。

ex.en: Local organisations can champion affordable housing by working with residents and presenting practical proposals to councils.
ex.zh: 地方组织可以与居民合作，向地方议会提交切实可行的提案，推动提供可负担住房。

tip: 作动词直接接宾语：champion a cause。

senses.en: very pleasant or attractive in a way that delights people

ex.en: We found a charming little café beside the river.
ex.zh: 我们在河边发现了一家迷人的小咖啡馆。

ex.en: Preserving charming historic neighbourhoods can attract visitors while strengthening residents' sense of belonging to their city.
ex.zh: 保护迷人的历史街区可以吸引游客，同时增强居民对城市的归属感。

tip: 既可形容人讨喜，也可形容地方迷人。

senses.en: relating to Christianity or its followers
a person who follows the religion based on Jesus Christ

ex.en: Our neighbour attends a Christian church near the park.
ex.zh: 我们的邻居去公园附近的一座基督教堂做礼拜。

ex.en: Christian charities, alongside other religious and secular organisations, provide essential support for vulnerable communities in many countries.
ex.zh: 在许多国家，基督教慈善机构与其他宗教及世俗组织一起，为弱势群体提供重要支持。

tip: 无论作名词还是形容词，首字母都要大写。

senses.en: A large tropical fruit with a hard shell and white flesh.
